summary.text: Rayburn is the Working Class Party nominee for Michigan's 6th District, nominated at the party's June 6, 2026 convention. She ran as a Working Class Party candidate for the Michigan legislature in 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ran as a Working Class Party candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 4 in 2020, losing the general election to Abraham Aiyash (D).
Ran for Michigan State Senate District 3 in 2022, losing the general election to incumbent Stephanie Chang (D).
Ran for Michigan House of Representatives District 7 in 2024, losing the general election to Tonya Myers Phillips (D).
